name: Ian Misner
headline: Cofounder at Kestrel · Building ecommerce apps for Shopify & WooCommerce · 25,000+ stores · Dad of 7
about:
I build e-commerce tools that merchants actually enjoy using. Currently running Kestrel, where we make extensions for Shopify and WooCommerce: checkout optimization, memberships, digital downloads, rentals, and about 40 other things store owners ask us for.

Zendra is our Shopify memberships app. We built it because every memberships app wasn't quite a memberships app. We make it easy for you to show your customers why they should sign up to pay you more than once. Ask me about it. 

FileFlare handles digital downloads on Shopify. CheckoutWC remains the best checkout solution for WooCommerce, and we maintain 40+ WooCommerce extensions across the Kestrel portfolio including Rental Products, Account Funds, Constellation, and more. 

Before Kestrel, I worked with SkyVerge, the largest independent WooCommerce extension company at the time. I stayed through the GoDaddy acquisition, learned what I wanted to build (and how I wanted to build it), and left before starting Kestrel with the former SkyVerge founders.

What I care about: making merchants successful, being unreasonably helpful on support, and building products based on what actual store owners tell us they need. When I'm not working, I'm probably watching a movie with one (or several) of my kids. 

Say hi. I answer my DMs.
… more

experiences.description:
Kestrel builds e-commerce extensions for Shopify and WooCommerce — memberships, checkout optimization, digital downloads, rentals, software licensing, and more. We're growing fast on Shopify with Zendra and FileFlare, and we maintain 40+ WooCommerce extensions that power thousands of stores.

I work closely with merchants, developers, and agencies to make sure we're building tools that drive revenue and reduce complexity. Our products are designed to be easy for merchants and even easier for developers to extend, support, and rely on.

We're building a small (but mighty) team committed to shipping standout e-commerce products across both platforms and providing the kind of support that people remember.

Product leadership for the SkyVerge suite of 40+ WooCommerce extensions
Responsible for commerce-related initiatives, powered by WooCommerce
